papers.title: Artifact rejection and decoding in motor imagery EEG
papers.abstract: We show that automated artifact rejection improves decoding accuracy in motor imagery EEG by 4.2 percentage points across 20 subjects.

papers.title: ICA-based cleaning and class-correlated artifacts
papers.abstract: Results suggest that ICA-based cleaning may reduce class-correlated artifacts in a public dataset of 9 subjects. We report decoding accuracy before and after cleaning.
